input.items: 2 ceiling fans, 1 dining table, 4 wall lights

result.summary: This budget plan allocates the ₹50,000 budget efficiently across the three rooms, focusing on a premium modern dining table from IKEA as the centerpiece of the living/dining area. The remaining budget is strategically distributed to source sleek, energy-efficient BLDC ceiling fans from Amazon and stylish, minimalist LED wall lights from Flipkart, leaving a healthy buffer for installation costs.

items.name: Modern 4-Seater Dining Table
items.suggestion: IKEA Sandsberg or Melltorp table with a minimalist matte metal frame and slim wooden top, offering a clean Nordic modern aesthetic.

items.name: 2 Ceiling Fans
items.suggestion: Atomberg Renesa 1200mm BLDC motor ceiling fans with remote control. Sleek, blade-free canopy design in matte black or white for a futuristic look.

items.name: 4 Wall Lights
items.suggestion: Minimalist up-and-down LED wall sconces in a matte black finish, emitting a warm yellow glow to elevate the bedroom and living room ambiance.

tips: Opt for BLDC motor ceiling fans; they not only look incredibly sleek and modern but also cut down your lighting electricity consumption by up to 65%.
Install the modern wall lights in pairs on opposite walls to create a balanced, symmetrical lighting layout that visually expands the rooms.
